title: Oncques amour (Bassano, five voices)
desc: Giovanni Bassano, Motetti, madrigali et canzoni francese (Venice, 1591), the keyboard version of “Oncques amour”, transcribed from a scan of the print (53 bars, the second half written out twice as in the print). The plain top part (the original canto) keeps its own staff; the harpsichord/organ part is taken apart into its four voices, one staff each, so that five voices sound together. The florid top part is left out. Some crowded places are uncertain, above all bars 39, 40, 49 and 50; voices cross and share notes in several bars. The print names Crecquillon; RISM, as quoted on IMSLP, links it to Clemens non Papa.
